messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex V, Part A, point 8

8. Where applicable, the notified body … (name, number) … performed the EU type-examination (Module B) and issued the EU type-examination certificate … (reference to that certificate), followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) or the conformity based on unit verification (module G) or full quality assurance (module H).

response.text:
notified body | performsEuTypeExamination | EU type-examination (Module B) | where applicable | "Where applicable, the notified body … performed the EU type-examination (Module B)"
notified body | issuesCertificate | EU type-examination certificate | where applicable | "issued the EU type-examination certificate … (reference to that certificate)"
conformity to type | isBasedOn | internal production control (module C) | where applicable; one of the listed alternatives | "followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C)"
conformity | isBasedOn | unit verification (module G) | where applicable; one of the listed alternatives | "or the conformity based on unit verification (module G)"
conformity | isBasedOn | full quality assurance (module H) | where applicable; one of the listed alternatives | "or full quality assurance (module H)"
